title: A Half-Blind Rhino Hears This Bird Before Any Human
subject: black rhinoceros

scenes.text: A rhino can barely see a human coming. A tiny bird fixes that.
Black rhinos have poor eyesight. Researchers in South Africa tested what happens when a bird rides along.
Without an oxpecker, rhinos noticed an approaching human only twenty-three percent of the time.
With one on its back, the rhino noticed every single human, from about sixty-one meters away.
The oxpecker calls out an alarm, and rhinos turn to face downwind to find the threat.
Nearly four times the warning distance, from a bird that weighs less than a coffee mug.

description:
